name: Dunwich
text: Dunwich () is a village and civil parish in Suffolk, England. It is in the Suffolk & Essex Coast & Heaths National Landscape around 92 miles (148 km) north-east of London, 9 miles (14 km) south of Southwold and 7 miles (11 km) north of Leiston, on the North Sea coast. In the Anglo-Saxon period, Dunwich was the capital of the Kingdom of the East Angles, but the harbour and most of the town have since disappeared due to coastal erosion.

depictions.text: Dunwich {{Update|Assassin's Creed: The Last Quest of Leonardo da Vinci}} thumb|250px|Dunwic Dunwic was a fort in the southeast of East Anglia, England. It was located on the region's eastern shore, facing the North Sea. History Middle Ages The fortress was unknowingly constructed atop Odin's Vault, an ancient Isu temple that could only be found using Odin's Eye and opened with Freya's medallion.Assassin's Creed: Valhalla – Mastery Challenge – The All-Seeing Eye During the late 9th century, Vikings from Rued's clan controlled the fort, which they used to plan an attack on the nearby Anglo-Saxon town of Norwich in 873.
